tip: Ding, ding-da-ding: the ride carries the time, hi-hat foot on 2 and 4.

name: Ride with feathered kick
tip: A very soft kick on every quarter: felt more than heard.

name: Comping on the snare
tip: The snare answers the ride: a ghost note on the & of 2 and an accent on the & of 3.

name: Jazz waltz
tip: Three beats per bar; the ride leads, and don't rush the 1.

tip: Triplets without the middle one: dum-da, dum-da. Snare on 2 and 4.

name: Maqsum
